entities.name: Bettina Heinen-Ayech
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bettina Heinen-Ayech was a German painter. She became known for her colorful landscape views of Algeria. Between 1955 and 2017 she had many exhibitions worldwide and won several prizes. Heinen-Ayech died on 7 June 2020.
